subject: Mutual action plan: hosting & region decision — escape hatch and gating
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@medivault.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan: hosting & region decision — escape hatch and gating

Elena — thanks again for the time today. As discussed, I’m attaching an updated MAP that ties the evaluation milestones to a single decision gateway: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private, and a regional constraint for EU data residency.

High-level asks for this thread:
- Confirm the regulatory constraint scope (PHI / patient-identifiable vs aggregated telemetry) and whether an EU-only data path is required for all traffic.
- Confirm the target close date for the procurement decision (we proposed 4/30).
- Flag any non-negotiable requirements that force Private deployment (on-prem/VPC).

What I’ve attached: a compact MAP (MAP-v3.xlsx) with sprint milestones for the eval, an options summary (redwood-deploy-options-summary.pdf), and a SOC2 evidence packet placeholder we can populate.

Proposed evaluation plan (timeline condensed):
1) Week 0–1: PoC dataset onboarding, smoke tests on Hosted (eu-west).
2) Week 2: Canary runs using Dedicated pool in eu-west with KV cache snapshotting.
3) Week 3: Resilience tests (regional failover to hosted in us-west) and latency validation.
4) Week 4: Exec decision and contract finalization.

Escape-hatch (what we offer if EU Dedicated is constrained):
- Short-term: Dedicated in eu-west with strict VPC peering and log retention controls.
- Medium-term: Private deployment (customer-managed VPC) for PHI-only flows if compliance team requests it.

Next steps: can you confirm by EOD 4/21 whether the evaluation can run against a representative PHI-feeding pipeline and whether procurement will prioritize a 4/30 signature?

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
From: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@medivault.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medivault.com, Sam Patel <sam.patel@medivault.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:03:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: hosting & region decision — escape hatch and gating

Thanks Karthik — good summary. A few clarifications from our side:
- Scope: We will be sending patient-level records for the initial PoC (PHI). That means EU data residency is required for both inference and persistence for any pipeline that touches PHI.
- Timeline: 4/30 is aggressive but preferred; procurement needs a final SOW and a redlines window. We can move fast if SOC2 artifacts and network diagrams are in hand.
- Non-negotiables: 1) Data-at-rest in eu-west, 2) Customer KMS for key management, 3) Audit logs exported to our SIEM.

Can you confirm whether a Dedicated-in-eu-west can satisfy the KMS/audit requirements immediately or whether Private is the only path? Also please send the SOC2 evidence (controls mapping) — we need it for our compliance team to triage.

Elena Garcia
Head of Security & Compliance, Medivault
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@medivault.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medivault.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: hosting & region decision — escape hatch and gating

Elena — quick legal/procurement notes from our side:
- We can support Dedicated in eu-west with customer-managed KMS via a Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) option; the contract will include an addendum for key-handling responsibilities.
- Data residency commitments will be captured in the Data Processing Addendum (DPA) and the SOW. We will need a 72-hour redlines window for contract language unless the procurement team flags specific statutory clauses.
- If Medivault requires on-prem (Private) for PHI, we’ll need a week to scope the on-prem packaging and a separate licensing agreement.

I’ll prepare a short procurement checklist and drop a DocuSign SOW link once we lock the deployment mode.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@medivault.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: hosting & region decision — escape hatch and gating

Elena — thanks for the constraints. I’ve updated the evaluation plan in MAP-v3.xlsx (attached) to reflect PHI-only traffic and a parallel test harness. Key changes: 
- Test matrix A: inference-only, eu-west Dedicated (no persistent PHI writes).
- Test matrix B: inference + persistence (requires BYOK + DPA) — run as a gated step after initial smoke tests.
- Fallback flow: if Dedicated provisioning time pushes past week 2, we will run an isolated Hosted tenant in eu-west (ephemeral, encrypted) for smoke, then migrate to Dedicated for canary.

Operational notes:
- We will provide a network diagram and SIEM export instructions by 4/23.
- We recommend a single-day exec review (30–45m) on 4/29 to approve final go/no-go.

Attachment: MAP-v3.xlsx (contains test steps, data masking checklist, and canary acceptance criteria).

Cheers,
Stephanie Nguyen
Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@medivault.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: hosting & region decision — escape hatch and gating

Team — I’m consolidating the MAP and pushing the milestones to our shared tracker. Proposed final timeline:
- 4/23: network diagram + SOC2 artifact delivery (Redwood) — DONE/IN-PROGRESS
- 4/26: Dedicated eu-west provisioning window (pending capacity), initial canary run
- 4/29: Exec review (30m) — decision to sign SOW or trigger Private scoping
- 4/30 EOD: Target signature (if all gates green)

Marissa, can you confirm availability for a 4/29 10:00–11:00 PT slot? Elena / Sam – if procurement needs an alternative cadence we can accommodate earlier.

Priyom Das
Product Manager — Redwood Inference
From: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@medivault.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, procurement@medivault.com
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 14:30:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: hosting & region decision — escape hatch and gating

All — quick update from our execs: they want to proceed with Dedicated in eu-west as the long-term production path for PHI. Procurement will accept a BYOK + DPA route. We’ll sign the SOW on 4/30 provided the DocuSign link contains the agreed BYOK clause and the DPA references eu-west residency.

Next actions on our side: procurement to review SOW and countersign; security to validate SOC2 mapping — see attached SOC2-evidence-response.pdf.

Elena Garcia
Head of Security & Compliance, Medivault

---
Attachments: SOC2-evidence-response.pdf
